verdict.rationale: Plausible documents both a Stats API (read-only query endpoint with API keys, JSON responses) and an Events API for recording pageviews/custom events server-side, giving programmatic access to core functionality. However missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probes show 404s), no llms.txt/machine-readable docs for AI agents, and no evidence of official SDKs or independent hands-on API integration reports.
